name: idxw_b2-v3-COMMIT
purpose: el1011-hbm-idxs: IDX.INDEX wide-lane frame adapter ot_hgi_idx_index_w (HBM B2, 8-lane slice-local wide read/write client): structural throughput redesign of the 8.60x IDX.INDEX record (serial packet-client keep walk / query stream / 1-lane compaction). ~30k flops, every port registered, sync reset from a local flop, no datapath reset. v3 (el1013-idxw-v3): exact lane-coherent pin plan after v2's PPL-0111 (W 2,194 / E 2,258 pins on 2,190 M4 slots): W M4 read group, S M3+M5 write group, N M3+M5 selector, E M4 frame command; outline unchanged, M5 cap, no M6. Conservative flat line; the regional split is el1013-idx-tiles.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_idx_index_w u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/idx/ot_hgi_idx_index_w.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/idxw_b2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/idxw_b2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/idxw_b2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_idx_index_w  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
